notes.title: YOU'LL BE SHOCKED BY THIS CHANGE: A NEW LEGENDARY ERA BEGINS!
notes.notes:
🎙 Top Sellers Family! 🎉

We are embarking on a very special journey, with you, with us, and together! We’ve been quiet for a while, but now we’re back with a completely new Top Sellers. 🚀

The journey we started with the first map is now evolving into a whole new world. The new map is not just a change of scenery; it’s an experience that will completely reshape the soul of the game! We’re starting in the e-commerce world and embarking on an incredible journey toward real-world commerce. And this is just the beginning… 🎮✨

And yes, you heard it right — this time, everything is going to be different. The new map, brand-new systems, and co-op mode are all waiting for you in this new Top Sellers experience. This update isn’t just a technical upgrade, it’s a revolution that will change the very heart of the game! We’ll be advancing in the world of commerce, and experiencing everything from a third-person perspective. With every step, we’ll encounter things you’ve never seen before.

But this journey isn’t just ours… It’s yours too! Every piece of feedback, every suggestion, every comment has helped shape this new world. Together, we’ve built this journey, and now we’re just a few steps away from expanding this universe even further!

Are you ready for this? We’re stepping into a new Top Sellers world together. Not just to play the game, but to explore the world, and take one more step toward new experiences. 💥

So, turn on your notifications because very soon, we’ll be presenting you with a surprise you never expected! 📢

Are you ready for this new journey together? Because we sure are! 🙌

With love,
Lymo Games Team 💙

notes.title: New Features & Improvements 🛑
notes.notes:
Hey, Top Sellers! 👋

The latest update is here, bringing exciting new features, improvements, and some cool new additions to make your trading journey even more fun! We've been working hard to make the game experience better for you, so get ready for a whole new level of gameplay. 🎮✨

[h2]New Features and Improvements 🎉[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Bank & Loan System 💰:[/b] You can now check out special bank offers based on your level, take out loans, and enjoy installment options! 🎯
[*] [b]Equipment Upgrades 🔧:[/b] We've made some great improvements to the existing equipment! New additions include the GPS map device, label printer, and tape machine. 🚀
[*] [b]Airplane Orders ✈️:[/b] The airport on the map is now active! Once you reach level 40, you can access it to view products with export demands, source them from wholesalers, and deliver them by plane! ✨ You’ll earn bonuses for completed orders and boost your profits! 💸
[*] [b]Notepad🌍:[/b] You can now track orders from the airport on your notepad equipment, even if you’re not at the airport itself! 📝
[*] [b]Labeling System Improvements 🏷️:[/b] Previously, you could label pallets to organize your staff. Now, you can also label shelves according to product categories, making your warehouse even more organized! 📦
[*] [b]Wholesaler Stock Improvements 🛍️:[/b] There have been improvements to the wholesaler stock based on your contract numbers. Especially in tech stores, you’ll be able to buy more computers and similar products! 💻
[*] [b]Equipment Bar UI Improvements 🎨:[/b] The equipment bar interface has been improved to be more user-friendly. 💡
[*] [b]Sound and Animation Improvements 🎶🎬:[/b] Sound and animation have been improved, making the overall experience more enjoyable! 😍
[*] [b]Localization Improvements 🌍:[/b] We’ve made small but important updates to the game’s language, making everything clearer! 🗣️
[/list]


[h2]Coming Soon 👀[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Bailiff ⚖️:[/b] A brand new bailiff feature is on the way! Get ready! 🛑
[*] [b]Warehouse Customization 🏠:[/b] Soon, you’ll be able to customize your warehouse with painting, decoration, and more! Ready to make your warehouse your own? 🎨
[*] [b]Vehicle Painting Feature 🚗:[/b] You’ll be able to paint and customize your vehicles! Create your own style! ✨
[*] [b]Antique Products and High Profits 💎:[/b] You’ll soon be able to buy antique products by train and make big profits! 🛤️
[*] [b]CO-OP Support 🤝:[/b] You and your closest friends will be able to continue your trading adventures together! Team up for even more fun! 💪
[/list]

We can’t wait for you to check out the new updates! 🎮 The game keeps getting better, so stay tuned for more! 👏

Enjoy the update and keep on trading! 💼

notes.title: Steam Deck Support Now Available for Top Sellers!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that Top Sellers now fully supports the Steam Deck! Whether you're at home or on the go, you can now enjoy seamless gaming on Valve’s powerful handheld device.

We’ve worked hard to ensure the best experience possible for Steam Deck players, with optimized controls and performance adjustments tailored for the device.

You can choose to use the Mezarkabul controller profile or create your own custom profile for the best gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45303721/0ee3951f8336063416dc4f1ce76ed5061d09ed92.png[/img]

notes.title: 🎉 The Huge Update is Live! 🚀
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to bring you the long-awaited news! With this massive update, we’ve taken our game to the next level. Exciting new features, improvements, and surprises await you. Let’s dive into the details:

[b]🆕 Brand New Features[/b]

[b]🌍 A Bigger Map[/b]
Expand your e-commerce empire on a larger map! Explore new areas and grow your business like never before.

[b]🚁 Drone Deliveries[/b]
You can now send express delivery orders via drones! The future of e-commerce is here.

[b]🔧 New Equipment System[/b]
• Take control of your warehouse—shelves, pallets, workbenches, and even lighting can now be managed from the equipment screen.
• Sell unnecessary equipment, buy new ones, and optimize your workflow!

[b]📱 Tablet[/b]
Say goodbye to running back and forth to your warehouse! Manage orders and stock directly from your tablet.

[b]⭐ New Level System[/b]
• Introducing a brand-new level system with 100 levels!
• Earn XP from completing orders, making purchases, and deliveries.
• Unlock new equipment and take your business to the next level.

[b]📦 Stock System for Wholesalers[/b]
No more unlimited supplies! Stock quantities at wholesalers are now limited, making supply planning a vital part of your strategy.

[b]🚚 Automated Deliveries[/b]
Let your trade manager handle deliveries—products purchased from wholesalers can now be sent directly to your warehouse. Focus on your strategies while we handle the logistics!

[b]🎁 New Store: Gift Shop[/b]
• Discover 45 brand-new gift items! Add a splash of color to your business with this exciting new category.

[b]💡 Game Balance Updates[/b]
• Market items are now only available for in-city deliveries.
• Cleaners can be delivered both in-city and locally.
• Tipping System: Customers are extra generous with in-city deliveries! Plus, these orders grant higher XP rewards.

[b]🏆 Leaderboard System[/b]
Check out the rankings from the main menu and see who’s generating the most revenue. The competition is on!

[b]📦 Order Fulfillment Enhancements[/b]
• Tape Machine: After placing products in boxes, you’ll now need to tape them for a more realistic packing experience.
• RFID Reader: Instead of automatically showing product locations in your warehouse, you’ll scan boxes to find where they’re stored.
• Enjoy enhanced packing animations with foam and other materials for a more immersive experience.

[b]🏷️ Labeling Systems[/b]
• Pallet Labeling: Easily decide which products go on which pallets.
• Vehicle Labeling: Specify which products your delivery driver needs to load onto the vehicle.

[b]⚙️ Settings Updates[/b]
• Added FPS limiting and reverse mouse axis (X-Y) options.
• New control screen for easier customization of gameplay settings.

[b]🕹️ Steam Deck Support[/b]
That’s right! You can now enjoy Top Sellers on Steam Deck!

[b]🔧 Improvements[/b]

[b]🚗 Improved Vehicle Handling[/b]
Driving is now smoother than ever! Experience easier turns and better vehicle physics for a more enjoyable driving experience.

[b]🔔 Notification Sounds[/b]
In-game notification sounds have been made softer and more pleasant.

[b]🌆 Visual Upgrades[/b]
City lighting and traffic signals have been revamped to make the environment more realistic and visually stunning.

[b]🔜 Coming Soon[/b]

[b]🚉 Trains and Airports[/b]
Have you noticed the train station and airport on the map? Stay tuned—these areas will soon become active, bringing exciting new gameplay elements!

[b]🚶‍♂️ NPCs and Traffic[/b]
We’re working on increasing the number of NPCs and enabling city traffic. Get ready for a livelier, more dynamic city!

[b]🔌 Electric Vehicles[/b]
Make your deliveries eco-friendly by switching to an electric vehicle! Manage charging and maintenance as part of your sustainable e-commerce strategy.

[b]💬 We Value Your Time[/b]
We know how much time and effort you’ve invested in the game, and we deeply respect that. That’s why we’ve introduced a migration system to ensure you don’t lose your progress!

When you log in and select "Continue Game," your previous progress will automatically migrate to the new system, allowing you to pick up right where you left off.

If you’d prefer, you can also start fresh to fully experience the new features and improvements. Whether you continue or start anew, the choice is yours! 😊

[b]💬 Your Feedback Matters![/b]
This update was shaped by your valuable feedback. Don’t forget to try out the new features and share your thoughts with us. Stay tuned for even more exciting content in the future!

Happy selling,
The Lymo Games Team

notes.title: Top Sellers: Big Update is Here + Exciting Features on the Way!
notes.notes:
First of all, a big thank you for your interest in our game, Top Sellers, and for all your valuable feedback! 💛 After seeing streamers experience and share our game, we carefully listened to both them and you, our beloved players. Based on your comments, we prioritized the most requested features and prepared an exciting new update. Plus, a brand-new trailer is coming your way very soon. Ready to dive into the details? 🚀

[b]🌟 What’s New?[/b]
[list]
[*] A Brand-New Map: We listened to your feedback and completely redesigned the map! It’s now more colorful, more fun, and packed with details waiting to be explored.
[*] Flea Market: We’ve added Flea Markets to two locations on the map. Here, you can find random products at prices well below the market value and purchase them by placing bids.
[*] New Employee: Stacker: You can now hire a Stacker!
[*] They help unload products from your vehicle.
[*] They stock shelves with items from boxes and dispose of empty boxes.
[*] Lightens your workload and keeps your storage area organized!
[*] Advanced Settings Menu: New graphical settings like texture quality and additional performance options have been added, allowing you to optimize the game for your system.
[*] Localization and Minor Fixes: We’ve improved localization and resolved minor bugs to enhance your experience.
[/list]

[b]🚀 What’s Coming Next?[/b]
In addition to this big update, we’d like to give you a sneak peek at some upcoming features:

[list]
[*] Drone Deliveries: City deliveries won’t rely solely on your courier anymore. With the Drone feature, you’ll be able to handle high-volume sales later in the game without worrying about delays.
[*] Remote Warehouse Management: Managing your warehouse is about to get easier! You’ll be able to purchase a tablet from the Equipment section to remotely manage your inventory and track stock.
[*] GPS for Easier Deliveries: From the Equipment section, you’ll also be able to buy a GPS device to easily see which box belongs to which NPC during city deliveries.
[*] Product Repair System: Repair broken products and return them to your sales inventory.
[*] Seasonal and Holiday Products: Celebrate special occasions like New Year, Halloween, and Valentine’s Day with exclusive seasonal products to spice up your sales.
[/list]

And much more!

Every piece of feedback from you is incredibly valuable to us. With your support, we’ll continue to make Top Sellers even better. Wishing you all happy gaming! 🎮

Warm regards,
The Top Sellers Team

notes.title: 📢 New Devlog for Top-Sellers: E-commerce Simulation is Here! 🚀
notes.notes:
Easier Object Rotation 🎉
You can now rotate objects not only with the Q and E keys but also using the mouse scroll! Just hold any object and scroll up or down to rotate it left or right.

Warehouse Level Update 📦
At Warehouse Level 1, you can now buy all products, not just popular ones. However, remember that popular products have a higher chance of selling, so it’s a good idea to prioritize them for more orders! 😊

Brighter Game Environment 💡
General lighting improvements have made the game environment brighter and clearer!

Localization Enhancements 🌍
We've made adjustments to improve text in languages like German and French. Now, the game is easier to understand for more players around the world.

End Interaction with ESC Key ✋
You can now end interactions with NPCs like the Carrier and Wholesaler by pressing the ESC key!

Faster Map Position Updates 📍
Your position on the map now updates more frequently, so it's easier to keep track of where you are!

Warehouse Worker Performance Boost 🚀
Our warehouse worker now completes orders faster, streamlining your workflow!

New Content Based on Delivery Times 📦
We’ve added new content in response to customer feedback regarding delivery times. Keeping customers happy is key!

Pause the Game with ESC ⏸️
Pressing the ESC key now pauses the game, so you can take a break without worrying about delivery times.

Text and Button Updates in the UI 🎨
We’ve refined text and button layouts across the UI for a cleaner, more polished look.

Interactive Object Indicator 🎯
When looking at an interactive object, the cursor now grows in a subtle animation. In its default view, it’s smaller and less intrusive.

Minor Bug Fixes and Optimizations 🛠️
Order rates have been optimized, and various minor bugs have been fixed.

Flea Dealers Map Pins Hidden for New Players 🗺️
To reduce confusion for new players, Flea Dealers map pins are temporarily hidden. They’ll be reactivated once the feature is finalized.

Mouse Sensitivity Setting Added 🎛️
You can now adjust your mouse sensitivity to your liking!
